name: zen-lsp
description: Zen language support: launches `zen lsp` and speaks LSP to it.

zen.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the Zen compiler binary, which `make build` writes to the root of the checkout. A relative path is resolved against the workspace folder. If the default `./zen` does not resolve, `zen` is looked up on the extension host's `PATH` as a fallback. An explicitly-set path that misses is reported as an error instead — no fallback — so a stale setting can never silently start a different binary than the one you asked for. **This path resolves on the machine the extension host runs on** — over a remote connection that is the remote host, which is where the source and the compiler are.

zen.server.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the server binary. The server speaks JSON-RPC over its own stdin and stdout, so `lsp` is the whole of it. Note that `vscode-languageclient` appends `--stdio` of its own accord and `zen lsp` reads that as an absent argument. If the launch shape changes, this is the one setting to change.

zen.sourceRoots.markdownDescription: Override the import root for a workspace-relative file or directory, such as a tool outside `src`. The longest matching path wins; directory matches stop at path-component boundaries. Both paths are relative to the language server's workspace folder. Absolute paths and `..` components are rejected; `root` may be `.`. Mapping paths must be unique. Requires a workspace folder. Changes restart the language server.

path.description: Workspace-relative file or directory to match, for example scripts/zen_usage.zen. Use a specific path, not .

root.description: Workspace-relative directory containing imported modules, for example src. Use . for the workspace root.

zen.trace.server.description: Log LSP traffic to the Zen output channel. Set to 'verbose' when the server will not start.
